sloka: तद्गच्छ शूलमादाय पाशहस्त इवान्तकः।वानरान् राजपुत्रौ च भक्षयादित्यतेजसौ ।। ६.६५.१३ ।।
transliteration: tadgaccha śūlamādāya pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ।vānarān rājaputrau ca bhakṣayādityatejasau ।। 6.65.13 ।।

translations.english: "Therefore, taking up trident holding the noose in hand like the God of Death proceed to devour the monkeys as well as the two princes shining like the Sun."
